blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) issued a work stoppage order against The Icon Clinic of Dr. Eric “Yappy” Yapjuangco on Oct. 7, following concerns about the clinic’s safety and operating standards. Labor Secretary Francis Tolentino also added the order was also issued amid the various cases already filed against the clinic. During a Lupong Pamagawa hearing on Oct. 8, Tolentino emphasized the clinic’s need to ensure the safety of its clients.
